beginner_version.found: Tiny separate things: a village of houses with cypresses in the left middle distance, many small bushes along the hills, a lake glint. Textures of hundreds of items: lavender stalks across the bottom 40% (busy outlined them, 10.4%). Detail inside big shapes: veined, curled clouds. Parts: more than 8 at different distances (sky, clouds, far hills, fields, village, bushes, golden hill, tree, balloon, sun, lavender rows, soil paths).
beginner_version.list: Remove the village and every cypress (plain green-gold fields there); merge the small bushes into two or three soft dark green bands; clouds become a few big soft orange and pink masses; far hills become two simple purple layers; remove the lake glint; the tree becomes one rounded crown of dark and mid green dabs; the lavender stalks across the bottom 40% become rows of loose purple dabs, darker at the base and lighter on top, with plain brown soil paths; keep the striped balloon with basket, the round low sun, the golden hill.
beginner_version.why: The picture had tiny separate things, a texture of hundreds of stalks, and more parts than the technique's detail budget (8). One render, kept: everything on the list went, fine texture fell from 10.4% to 0.0%, and the balloon, basket, sun and tree are all there.

canvas_fit.canvas: 16 x 12 in, landscape (default: the standard size closest to the photo's 3:2 shape)
canvas_fit.lost: about 7% from the left edge (sky, clouds and a strip of field) and 4% from the right edge (clouds and hill)
canvas_fit.why: fit-canvas picked the free crop: the balloon, sun, tree and lavender rows all stay whole.

photo_prep.subject: A striped hot air balloon over a sunset lavender field in Provence: orange and pink clouds, a low sun over far purple hills, a tree on a golden hill at right, a small village with cypresses at left, and lavender rows running toward the viewer.
photo_prep.why: An AI-made painting with no app bars, borders, captions, or watermark; everything in it is the scene.

considered.name: Block in, then build up (acrylic-block-in-beginner)
considered.why_not: It has no version 2 keys (v2_step_range, v2_rules), so a v2 plan can't follow it.

technique.why: Paint-along, back to front, is the beginner approach for a landscape: sky first, then each layer of land, the balloon and tree, and the lavender in front last. It's also the only technique with version 2 rules.
